title: Payment Product Manager
description: Growe welcomes those who are excited to:• Decide how the hub behaves: make system behavior explicit (such as callback timeouts, withdrawal hold and release rules, gateway configuration setups, and player-facing error messages) rather than leaving these details in engineers' heads or partner systems; • Own the back office: drive and optimize the seven core operational screens used daily by internal teams (projects, gateways, payment groups, methods, orders, transactions, and logs) to ensure the hub remains fully usable; • Run discovery against internal systems: lead timeboxed spikes across eleven internal systems (including player accounts, wallet, KYC, fraud checks, reconciliation, and taxation) to rank findings by risk and resolve unknowns before they turn into rework; • Sequence the regional migration: define rollout stages, set validation rules using small percentages of live traffic and historical transaction replays, establish criteria for moving to the next step, and prepare clear rollback plans; • Keep regional teams aligned and informed: maintain strong trust and clear communication with local operations, support, and business owners regarding upcoming changes, potential risks, and contingency plans; • Plan for life after launch: establish operational processes for incident management, configuration changes, new method onboarding, and ongoing integration health once a region goes live.
